messages:
Auditor (Lisa): hi team — for SOC2 fieldwork we need a short live-replay (not full export) showing the RBAC change to svc-infer that happened during the vuln triage on 2026-03-10. Also need proof that the KMS key associated with the infer pipeline was used to decrypt artifacts during the triage window. Can you provide timestamps + a presigned link?
Zoe H: thanks Lisa, we can do a trimmed replay. which exact triage window do you want? timezone?
Auditor (Lisa): window is 2026-03-10 14:22:00 -> 2026-03-10 14:57:00 UTC. one file with redacted IPs is fine. need KMS usage logs showing decrypt calls correlated to the service-account.
Mike D: ok. we have two pieces: RBAC change audit (k8s rolebinding + iam logs) and KMS CloudAudit log entries. I can extract both and produce a presigned S3 artifact.
Raj P: I can run the extraction script. suggest we pull:
```
# splunk-like query for RBAC changes (example)
index=redwood-prod "roleBinding" svc-infer earliest=03/10/2026:14:00:00 latest=03/10/2026:15:00:00 | table _time actor action resource
```
and for KMS (GCP/AWS): filter by key_id and operation=Decrypt and correlate by callerEmail/serviceAccount.
Lina S: note on redaction: we should mask requester IPs and any user emails not in scope. I can automate a redaction step before upload. also confirm retention SLA — the auditor gets a time-limited link only. :lock: 
Zoe H: @Mike D @Raj P can you include the correlation mapping file that shows how we matched the RBAC event to the KMS decrypt (timestamp alignment + actor). auditor will want chain-of-custody text.
Mike D: yes. I'll add a short README with: what was extracted, queries used, hashes of artifacts, and the redaction checklist. will run on staging first.
Raj P: starting extraction now. ETA ~10m. will output: rbac_events.jsonl, kms_decrypts.jsonl, correlation.csv.
deploy-bot: presign job queued (job id: ps-98371)
Mike D: once extraction done I'll trigger presign with 72h validity and post here.
Auditor (Lisa): thanks. two quick Qs: 1) will the KMS logs include the key alias or only key id? 2) do you include ephemeral admin actions (jumpbox sudo) in the RBAC timeline?
Zoe H: 1) logs include key_id and alias for our cloud provider, we will surface both. 2) We include service-account rolebinding changes and any admin console changes; for jumpbox sudo we include the session start/stop markers but redact command outputs unless requested.
Lina S: tagging compliance: we will note any excluded PII and the redaction rationale in the README.
Mike D: extraction finished. artifacts hashed. creating presigned link now.
deploy-bot: presign ready -> https://s3.redwood-example.com/ps/ps-98371?r=exp72h (REDACTED LINK FOR THREAD)
Mike D: uploaded README and correlation.csv. Hashes: rbac_events.jsonl sha256: 3f5a...a1c, kms_decrypts.jsonl sha256: b7c2...9d0
Raj P: auditor, please confirm you can access the link and whether you need a verbatim session replay or the JSONL timeline is sufficient.
Auditor (Lisa): I can access. JSONL timeline + correlation.csv + README is sufficient. please keep the presign 72h. appreciate the redaction notes.
Zoe H: marking this as evidence export for SOC2. I'll add an entry to the evidence tracker with ticket #SEC-2026-314.
Lina S: adding checklist: redaction performed, hash verified, presign expiry, IAM audit included. closing loop once auditor confirms. :white_check_mark:
